Likewise, in its mission, the project seeks to strengthen bi-regional cooperation between Latin America and the Caribbean with Europe, taking advantage of the impulse that feminist foreign policy in both regions is giving to the development of comprehensive care policies and systems. Under the guidance and direct supervision of the Deputy Regional Director, the Regional Programme Specialist will be responsible for providing strategic leadership and comprehensive management of the care program. The incumbent will substantively and operationally coordinate the implementation of programmed care activities, ensure effective articulation between the different components of the project, and ensure the achievement of results and implementation of activities in accordance with the Project Document approved by UN Women and the donor and other applicable reference documents. The Regional Programme Specialist will work closely with the economic empowerment team, specifically the technical care specialists and operations team of the UN Women regional office, as well as the economic empowerment teams of the UN Women country offices in Latin America and the Caribbean. Support and oversee the reporting and produce regional analysis including global trends and identifying challenges. Develop and maintain implementation workplans, ensuring timelines are realistic, risks are identified early, and all parties are aligned. Conduct and oversee readiness assessments (staff capacity, infrastructure, master data, and system prerequisites) before each implementation phase. Ensure all pre-implementation requirements are fully met before authorizing progression to the next stage. Coordinate cross-functional teams (technical, medical, supply chain, M/E) and external partners throughout the implementation lifecycle. Track progress against milestones, proactively manage risks and delays, and escalate issues with recommended solutions. System Setup, Quality Assurance and Go-Live Own the end-to-end verification of system configurations against agreed technical specifications and operational requirements. Review and approve facility setups, user access controls, permission structures, item master lists, and location hierarchies. Ensure the completeness and accuracy of initial data loads before go-live. Lead go-live execution, verifying that core daily workflows — including receiving, dispensing, requisitions, transfers, and reporting — are functioning correctly. Identify, document, and drive resolution of issues in coordination with technical, partner, and support teams. Provide final go-live sign-off based on established readiness criteria. Review and validate the implementation work of junior officers and field staff before sign-off. Quality Checks, Issue Management and Continuous Improvement Ensure all implementation activities comply with approved standard operating procedures and quality standards. Validate that configured workflows support real-world operational and reporting needs at each site. Maintain accurate issue logs, monitor resolution progress, and escalate unresolved issues appropriately. Provide structured troubleshooting support during rollout and system stabilization phases. Develop and review implementation reports, site sign-off documents, and handover notes to a high standard. Mentor and support junior implementation staff through structured coaching and on-the-job guidance. Monitor early system usage patterns post-go-live to detect adoption risks and proactively address them. Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.
